findings: The static boundary check is recorded as passed and verifies the project-run static metadata path remains separate from dynamic strategy preflight imports.
Windows 11 dynamic acceptance confirms descendants that outlive their direct parent are reaped after both normal return and timeout.
The evidence and documentation state that POSIX children deliberately starting a new session escape the owned process group.

After adding POSIX cleanup for descendants that remain after a normal response, the Windows 11 return/timeout process-tree regression acceptance still passes. Linux CI now contains a detached new-session child case that records the ownership boundary and reaps the fixture child.
The Windows process-tree acceptance still passes after the Linux-only zombie-aware exit probe was added to the POSIX detached-session fixture.
limitations: Linux/POSIX dynamic cleanup has not been run.
